RefAddrObjectTypeDefArray.notes: Array of 11 type-def pointers in .data. STATIC CORROBORATION in this build: read 11 consecutive u32 at 0x1FCB78 = [0x1FC228,0x1FC2D0,0x1FC420,0x1FC4D0,0x1FC578,0x1FC628,0x1FC6D0,0x1FC8D0,0x1FC978,0x1FCA28,0x1FCAD8] — all 11 are plausible low-GVA pointers into the image, and (HiBound 0x1FCBA4 - 0x1FCB78)/4 = 11, matching the M19 retail result to the byte. Pointers resolve in low-GVA engine .data; translate per-pointer via QMP at runtime, NOT HighGVA arithmetic. Not runtime-verified on THIS build. || RUNTIME-VERIFIED 2026-06-19 in xemu 0.8.136 via QMP on the layout-identical sibling ce-lowdetail-30 (byte-identical at this offset per the overlap check; values match this baseline's static prediction exactly): live read of 11 consecutive u32 @0x1FCB78 = [0x1FC228,0x1FC2D0,0x1FC420,0x1FC4D0,0x1FC578,0x1FC628,0x1FC6D0,0x1FC8D0,0x1FC978,0x1FCA28,0x1FCAD8], byte-for-byte identical to the static prediction.

RefAddrObjectTypeDefArrayHi.notes: Upper bound of the object-type-def array, used by the engine as the array-end pointer. (Hi - Array) = 0x2C = 44 bytes = 11 entries. Recorded so the count is derivable without hardcoding 11. || RUNTIME-VERIFIED 2026-06-19 in xemu 0.8.136 via QMP on the layout-identical sibling ce-lowdetail-30 (byte-identical at this offset per the overlap check; values match this baseline's static prediction exactly): the 11-entry array ends exactly at 0x1FCBA4 (=0x1FCB78+0x2C), confirmed live by the matching 11-pointer read.

ConstObjectTypeDefCount.notes: Derived count = (RefAddrObjectTypeDefArrayHi - RefAddrObjectTypeDefArray)/4 = 11. Matches M19. A constant (not an address), so it is layout-relative and passes through export unchanged. || RUNTIME-VERIFIED 2026-06-19 in xemu 0.8.136 via QMP on the layout-identical sibling ce-lowdetail-30 (byte-identical at this offset per the overlap check; values match this baseline's static prediction exactly): (0x1FCBA4-0x1FCB78)/4 = 11, confirmed live by the matching 11-pointer read.
